page.description: NixOS 26.05 ISO images: architectures, sizes and the channel's SHA-256 table.
page.intro: A Linux distribution built around the Nix package manager: the whole system is described in configuration and rebuilt from it. Graphical and minimal ISOs for x86_64 and aarch64.
pros: Declarative configuration: the system is rebuilt from a file, reproducibly.
Rollbacks are a boot-menu entry, not a restore procedure.
Upgrades and rebuilds are the same operation.
Both graphical and minimal images for two architectures.
cons: The Nix language and store take real learning.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so the page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for NixOS; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: One ISO per edition and architecture, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk. The release date shown is the 26.05 channel's own date line.
